transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... I suppose it's because I've been having some trouble keeping up with conversations. Like, at the museum where I volunteer, people will be talking right to me about the upcoming art walk... and I'll be looking right at them, but then I realize I completely missed the middle part of what they said. I end up having to ask them to run it by me again. It's just... getting a bit frustrating.
Do you find that you have trouble following conversations or staying focused in other situations, like at home or with friends?

I suppose... yeah. It happens when I read, mostly. I'll sit down with a gallery packet or some notes. I start out fine, but... after a few minutes, my eyes are just moving over the page. My mind wanders off somewhere else. I end up having to read the same part all over again. So... yes.
Do you often feel restless or on edge, like you can't relax even when there's no immediate stressor?
No... I wouldn't say that. I don't really feel... on edge. I'm fine just sitting quietly, mostly. So, no.
Have you noticed feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in activities you usually enjoy, like volunteering at the museum?
No, not really. I still like going to the museum. I haven't been feeling down or... hopeless. Just the trouble with focusing, like I mentioned. That's all.

F90.0 (Attention-Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder, Predominantly Inattentive Type) remains consistent with the reported difficulties in maintaining focus and attention.
